settings.notifications: The bar, and being told things
settings.notifications_note: At most two notifications a day in total, whatever is switched on here. Anything over that is dropped rather than queued.
settings.showLevel: Show the level beside the hero
settings.notifyExpedition: Tell me when an expedition is home
settings.notifyQuests: Tell me when the day is sealed
settings.sensorAgents_note: Reads token totals from ~/.local/state/omarchy/agents/usage/. Numbers only — never a prompt, never an answer. Omaquest refreshes those files itself, so nothing else has to be switched on for this to work.
settings.sensorGit_note: Counts commits with git rev-list, every half hour, in the folder below. Never a message, a file name, an author, or the name of a repository.
settings.bard_note: Adds one button to the Chronicle that launches your own Omarchy agent to write the day up. Your agent, your quota, as often as you ask, and nothing runs without the click.
settings.calling_note: A calling is a lens on where experience comes from, not a cage. Changing it costs {gold} gold and keeps your level.
settings.rebirth_confirm: Level, experience and everything worn go. The chronicle, the materials, the gold and the feats stay. There is no undo.
settings.what_it_reads_body: Counts, and nothing else. Which workspace you are on and how many windows opened; whether an application was new today and whether it was a terminal — the class is read to answer that and dropped, and the window title is never read at all. Whether you are at the machine, whether something is playing (never what), your theme's colours, and the battery if there is one. Programs that crashed, by the name of the executable: the core file is never opened. It writes only to ~/.local/state/omaquest/ and to its own settings entry. It never touches the network.
chron.reborn.1: The records stay. Everything else starts over: {name}, {race} {cls}.
bard.title: The Bard's Song
bard.prompt: Read the short text file {brief} and nothing else. Write about 150 words in {language}, in the voice of a medieval bard who was there, about the most recent day it describes. Use the hero's name and the realm's name. Prefer the shape of the day to a list of events. Save it as plain prose to {out}, replacing whatever is there. Do not open any other file, do not run any other command, and do not report anything back.

settings.gitPath: Where your repositories are — searched one level deep, and only for .git folders
arena.lost_kept: Your level, your gold, your gear and your feats are untouched. Only the climb toward this level got shorter.
settings.calling_confirm: Become a {cls}? It costs {gold} gold and there is no refund. Your level, experience, gear and gold stay as they are; the attributes re-derive for the new calling, so some go up and some go down.
ui.chest_empty: Nothing put away. What you forge and what you do not wear ends up here.
ui.feats_note: Earned once and kept for good — even through a rebirth. Everything below is read from this machine.
